title: Search & Scraping Tools
summary: This module provides a comprehensive suite of tools for performing web searches, extracting content from web pages, and querying various structured and unstructured data sources.

nodes.label: Brave Search Tools
nodes.title: Brave Search Tools
nodes.description: Integrates with the Brave Search API to perform web searches and retrieve local points of interest.

nodes.label: Bright Data Tools
nodes.title: Bright Data Tools
nodes.description: Leverages Bright Data for advanced SERP searches and web content unlocking and scraping.

nodes.label: File & Data Search
nodes.title: File and Data Search
nodes.description: Enables semantic search within various file types (CSV, DOCX, JSON, PDF, TXT, XML) and structured data sources like MySQL, SingleStore, and Snowflake.

nodes.label: Scraping Services
nodes.title: Scraping Frameworks & Services
nodes.description: Provides tools for web scraping and crawling using dedicated services like Firecrawl, Jina, Scrapfly, Hyperbrowser, Browserbase and Selenium.

nodes.label: Oxylabs Tools
nodes.title: Oxylabs Tools
nodes.description: Facilitates advanced scraping from Amazon and Google Search results, as well as general web content, using Oxylabs API.

nodes.label: Tavily Tools
nodes.title: Tavily Tools
nodes.description: Offers tools for web search, content extraction, and advanced research task management using the Tavily API.

nodes.label: Other Search APIs
nodes.title: Other Search APIs
nodes.description: Includes various other specialized search and scraping API integrations like Exa, Serper, and SerpApi.

groups.label: Brave API
groups.title: Brave API Integration
groups.description: Tools that interact with the Brave Search API for web search and local information retrieval.

groups.label: Bright Data API
groups.title: Bright Data API Integration
groups.description: Tools utilizing Bright Data for SERP searches and advanced web unlocking and scraping capabilities.

groups.label: Data Sources
groups.title: Data Source Search & Integration
groups.description: Tools for searching and interacting with various structured and unstructured data formats and databases.

groups.label: Web Scraping & Crawling
groups.title: Web Scraping and Crawling Services
groups.description: Tools that use specialized services and frameworks for comprehensive web scraping and crawling.

groups.label: Oxylabs API
groups.title: Oxylabs API Integration
groups.description: Tools for specialized e-commerce and search scraping via the Oxylabs platform.

groups.label: Tavily API
groups.title: Tavily API Integration
groups.description: Tools that interface with the Tavily API for web search, content extraction, and managing research tasks.

groups.label: Misc. Search APIs
groups.title: Miscellaneous Search APIs
groups.description: Collection of tools integrating with various other search and scraping APIs.
